trial_court: Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, Jagraon (HMA/345/2022)
facts_of_case: The respondent-husband filed a petition under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. He was in judicial custody at Central Jail, Ludhiana and sought time to seek fresh instructions.

legal_principles.principle: To maintain a petition at the hands of the respondent-husband under Section 9 of the Act would be an abuse of judicial process.
legal_principles.held: In such a situation, to maintain a petition at the hands of the respondent-husband under Section 9 of the Act (supra), would be abuse of judicial process and in the aforesaid circumstances calling upon the petitioner-wife to contest such petition would be a travesty of justice.

legal_principles.principle: Courts should give more weightage and consideration to the convenience of the female litigants.
legal_principles.held: The Courts are required to give more weightage and consideration to the convenience of the female litigants and transfer of legal proceedings from one Court to another should ordinarily be allowed, taking into consideration their convenience and the Courts should desist from putting female litigants under undue hardships.
cited_cases: Sumita Singh vs Kumar Sanjay, AIR 2002 SC 396
Rajani Kishor Pardeshi vs Kishor Babulal Pardeshi, (2005) 12 SCC 237

legal_principles.principle: The ends of justice should demand the transfer of suit, appeal or other proceeding.
legal_principles.held: The cardinal principle for exercise of power under section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure is that the ends of justice should demand the transfer of suit, appeal or other proceeding.
cited_cases: N.C.V. Aishwarya vs. A.S. Saravana Karthik Sha, 2022 SCC Online SC 1199

legal_principles.principle: The Court is to consider the family condition of the wife, the custody of the minor child, economic condition of the wife, her physical health and earning capacity of the husband.
legal_principles.held: Accordingly, it is well settled that while considering the transfer of a matrimonial dispute/case, at the instance of the wife, the Court is to consider the family condition of the wife, the custody of the minor child, economic condition of the wife, her physical health and earning capacity of the husband.

outcome.final_order: The petition was transferred to a Court of competent jurisdiction at Nawanshahr.
